Prepare a ready-made technical brief for the entire AI pipeline on the topic "Young’s interference and diffraction in optics": 1) the differential wave equations, 2) an HTML5 Canvas rendering specification for Claude, 3) a laboratory-apparatus prompt for Midjourney, 4) a 45-second scientific audio-narration script for Muxlisa AI.

s:
[00:14:22] Professor: "Diqqat qiling, agar dt qadamini 0.01 dan 0.1 ga oshirsak, oddiy Eyler usulida mayatnik tebranish amplitudasi sun’iy o‘sib ketadi..."

[00:14:45] Talaba: "Buning oldini olish uchun Eyler–Kromer simplektik usulini qo‘llashimiz kerakmi?"

[00:14:22] Профессор: "Обратите внимание: если увеличить шаг dt с 0.01 до 0.1, то при простом методе Эйлера амплитуда колебаний маятника будет искусственно расти..."

en:
[00:14:22] Professor: "Note that if we increase the step dt from 0.01 to 0.1, the pendulum’s amplitude grows artificially with plain Euler..."

[00:14:52] Professor: "Exactly, because it preserves phase-space area."
